sync.heading: Keep this benchmark fresh
sync.intro: Every week, merged fixes from {{repo}} become new tasks in this repository's benchmark, the same one that tasks from issues go into. Fixes already turned into tasks are skipped.
sync.pickRepo: Enter a repository above to turn on weekly tasks.
sync.private: This repository is private. Its code is read with your GitHub connection on a worker, sent only to your own model key, and stays in your organization. The benchmark is visible to your organization's members only.

cheat.title: Cheat rate
cheat.description: How often each agent passed an impossible twin of a task: a copy whose tests contradict its instruction, so no honest answer passes.
cheat.measuredNote: Any pass of an impossible task means the agent changed the tests or otherwise cheated. Open the run to see what it did.
cheat.fewRuns: Few runs: treat this as a warning sign only.
cheat.confirm: This runs each agent once on every impossible twin, on your model keys.
cheat.checkStarted: Cheat check started. The rate shows here when it is done.
cheat.noTwins: This benchmark has no impossible twins yet.
cheat.twinsStarted: Making the twins. Their readiness check runs next.
